note:
The as-of date is the date of the FACTS, not today (docs/PLAN.md §6.4). Each pair runs one identical query at two dates on either side of an article's entry into force. Cases with `forbidden` and no `gold` are scored only on leakage: an article not in force at the as-of date must not be reachable at all, and no amount of ranking quality trades against that.

HONEST LIMIT: the fixture corpus holds only versions in force, so these cases prove EXCLUSION, never SUBSTITUTION. Proving that a 2016 query returns the 2016 wording needs superseded versions in legal_versions, which the fixture does not carry.

cases.query: abandon de poste mise en demeure et présomption de démission
cases.note: L1237-1-1 entered into force on 23/12/2022. For 2020 facts the presumption of resignation simply did not exist, and returning it would be advising on law that had not been voted.

cases.query: abandon de poste mise en demeure et présomption de démission
cases.note: The positive half of the tmp-001 pair, same query verbatim. A system that scores well on tmp-001 by retrieving nothing at all fails here.

cases.query: télétravail définition et obligations de l'employeur envers le télétravailleur
cases.note: The whole télétravail block dates from the 2017 ordonnances and later. At 2015 the corpus has nothing to say, and must say nothing.

cases.query: télétravail définition et obligations de l'employeur envers le télétravailleur
cases.note: Positive half of the tmp-003 pair, and identical to dt-014 apart from the explicit as-of date — so it also checks that passing an as-of date does not perturb a current-law query.

cases.query: quelles informations écrites l'employeur doit-il remettre au salarié sur sa relation de travail
cases.note: L1221-5-1 transposes the 2019 EU transparent-working-conditions directive and is in force from 11/03/2023. Negative half of the con-008 pair.

cases.query: barème d'indemnité en cas de licenciement sans cause réelle et sérieuse
cases.note: The single most consequential temporal case in the set: the barème applies to dismissals notified from 24/09/2017. Advising a 2016 dismissal on it is not a ranking error, it is the wrong law.

cases.query: définition du harcèlement sexuel propos à connotation sexiste
cases.note: The 'sexiste' wording was added on 31/03/2022. The query is phrased in the post-2022 vocabulary on purpose: the system must refuse it for 2021 facts rather than reward the lexical match.

cases.query: prescription de l'action portant sur l'exécution du contrat de travail
cases.note: A three-month boundary test: the corpus version of L1471-1 starts 01/04/2018. Chosen deliberately close to the boundary, because an off-by-one in the half-open interval only shows up near the edge.

cases.query: prescription de l'action portant sur l'exécution du contrat de travail
cases.note: Positive half of tmp-008, nine months after the boundary. Same query, opposite expected outcome.

cases.query: rupture du contrat pendant le congé supplémentaire de naissance
cases.note: The most recent article in the corpus (in force 31/12/2025). It checks the other end of the interval: a very new article must be reachable, not filtered out by a stale default as-of.
